tasks.title: Bind publication plans to exact subjects
tasks.goal: Extend the existing distribution evidence chain with a canonical prepared-publication subject and effect plan.
steps: Map current source/tree/lock/bundle fields and each remote write in prepare_with; retain their owners.
Create PROP-060 anchors for exact subjects, smoke policy and effect partitions; define framed hashes including target, replaced remote IDs and recovery prerequisites.
Register owned schemas/corpora and implement pure plan construction/validation through the existing manifest types; expose model/error schema references using M-16.
positive_cases: Same captured inputs produce the same subject/plan digest.
A local plan lists every intended remote mutation without performing it.
negative_cases: Different bundle, target, lock or replacement generation changes/refuses the subject.
An incomplete bundle set cannot produce an apply-ready plan.
checks: SELECT BEFORE DISPATCH: vibe-publish target/cases are TO BIND from source/metadata to affected positive/negative obligations; choose --lib, --test <name>, --bin <name>, or affected --doc before compiling.

RUN BOUND CHECKS: after binding, use cargo test -p vibe-publish <target> <case> -- --exact for lib/test/bin, or a reviewed small family without --exact; bind supported rustdoc selection separately. Verify intended nonzero cases in output; use target-specific --list only when needed to confirm selection, and reuse its valid inventory.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask check-codegen only when the actual diff affects schemas, generators, generated-output registration or a dependent contract. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask wire-diff only when the actual diff affects wire/format behavior, its corpus or epoch semantics. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- check --path . --quiet only when actual spec/boot/dependency composition impact requires whole-project validation. Otherwise bind an existing appropriate root or focused declared-source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo run --quiet -p vibe-cli -- facts check --exhaustive only when actual facts/adoption/reference/extraction or closure-contract impact requires exhaustive validation. Otherwise bind affected claim/source checks; the write perimeter alone is not a trigger.
cargo fmt --all -- --check
git diff --check
acceptance: Plan and corpus show exact binding from source to all bundles and destinations.
Filesystem/network spies show plan construction performs no publication.
tasks.safe_stop: A inspectable local plan exists; no remote writer is called.
tasks.commit_subject: feat(publish): bind prepared plans to exact release subjects
notes: PROP-060 is a proposed canonical file created by this task, not a baseline existing source. Schema/module filenames are finalized within the listed subtrees before coding.
Prerequisites: M-13, M-14-A and M-16-B; do not duplicate their operation or target identity models.

Schema changes: inspect the existing codegen entrypoint before regeneration; never hand-edit generated types or invent a new codegen command. The listed check-codegen and wire-diff oracles are conditional on the actual affected inputs, never on the allowed write perimeter alone.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

tasks.title: Evaluate A approvals and disabled B policy
tasks.goal: Implement the shared pure authorization decision for an exact prepared plan.
steps: Consume the subject from .1 and M-16/M-14 identity carriers; define approved/needs-approval/refused outcomes with reasons.
Implement A receipt matching and B scope/epoch/expiry/revocation evaluation over the same effect plan; default live mode stays A.
Bind policy generation, target, principal, operations, captures and effective smoke policy; return structured decisions without activating B or editing policy.
positive_cases: An exact A approval admits one unchanged batch.
An explicitly enabled test B policy admits the identical bounded batch.
negative_cases: Expired/revoked/out-of-scope policy and changed plan refuse before writes.
Prototype status, prior success and an installed descriptor do not enable B.
